01Check these first

Chris's drawings are his own design, not a build spec. These are the places where his numbers and ours don't line up yet.

  1. Width. Chris has the hut at 5500 × 2400. We agreed the body goes 2.6 m wide (floor and walls) on the 2.4 m chassis, overhanging 10 cm each side, so it qualifies for 5% VAT.
  2. Door to pergola beam. His section through the door has the beam only 130 mm above the door head (door head 2700, beam underside 2830). You said we need about 200 mm.
  3. Louvres opening. Chris has asked for at least 50 mm more between the top of the pergola beam and the hut roof edge, so the louvres can tilt fully upright. On his numbers that puts the roof edge at 3100 or higher. He will measure his neighbour's pergola next week.
  4. Pergola size. His pack shows a 4 × 3 m pergola. Marta posted a 4 × 4 m Bulhawk link on 13 Oct. Which one is it?
  5. Wall and door heights. His pack has a 750 × 1950 stable door. As you said on 16 Oct, a 1.95 m wall with a 1.95 m door leaves no room for the frame.
What we need from you
  • Chassis length, width and height from the ground to the top of the frame
  • Distance from the tow bar end to the centre of each wheel
  • Final body size you're building (5.5 × 2.6 m?)
  • Wall height, roof height and overhang each side
  • Door width, height and where it sits along the front
